chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever falsely accuses a believing man or woman, or speaks about him/her what is not in him, Allah will make him stand on the Day of Resurrection on a hill of fire until he emerges from what he said about him.

key_terms.بَهَتَ: To falsely accuse or speak ill of someone

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of falsely accusing a believer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the severity of *al-ghibah* (backbiting) and *al-buhtan* (false accusation) by depicting a literal expulsion of the spoken falsehood through a physical manifestation of fire. In Shia scholarly tradition, this serves as a potent reminder of divine justice, where the specific sin dictates the specific punishment, emphasizing the spiritual weight of one's words against fellow believers.
